tvShow.name: CIA
tvShow.overview: When by-the-book FBI Special Agent Bill Goodman is loaned out to a clandestine CIA/FBI task force, he finds himself teamed up with secretive and roguish CIA case officer Colin Glass. Together they work covert operations in New York, uncovering international plots, terrorist cells, and geopolitical secrets.

episodes.name: Directed Energy
episodes.overview: When a top-secret weapon is stolen from a U.S. defense contractor, CIA agent Colin Glass is paired with FBI agent Bill Goodman to investigate. Their partnership gets off to a rocky start, but they soon realize their opposing viewpoints may be their greatest asset.

episodes.name: Fatal Defect
episodes.overview: When a known smuggler is flagged at the New York border with unidentified cargo, Colin and Bill head upstate to track. To find this smuggler, they must enlist the help of a foreign intelligence officer looking to defect.

episodes.name: Bridge of Lies
episodes.overview: When a deeply embedded U.S. intelligence officer is detained in Hong Kong, Nikki insists on traveling there to bring him home but her cover is blown.

episodes.name: Forced Labor
episodes.overview: When a wanted Belarusian national is discovered posing as an expecting father, Colin and Bill work to expose an international illegal baby smuggling ring.

episodes.name: Deep Cover
episodes.overview: After a cyber engineer and her family are killed in a targeted attack, Colin and Bill rush to stop the culprits before they strike again.

episodes.name: Pledge of Allegiance
episodes.overview: After Colin receives a tip on an upcoming terror plot, the team recovers a young man who was kidnapped nine years ago in Turkey and dig into his time in captivity to help stop the attack. Meanwhile, Bill looks into someone very close to Colin.

episodes.name: Elimination Game
episodes.overview: When handling security for an international soccer game, a bomb threat leads Colin and Bill to two players who are being hunted after they go missing. As the case evolves, the team leans on FBI's Special Agent in Charge Isobel Castille.

episodes.name: Orbital
episodes.overview: When a crashed satellite containing dangerous nuclear material disappears, Bill and Colin work with an undercover Gina to recruit the help of a retired arms dealer to help track it down.

episodes.name: Blood Money
episodes.overview: A woman with intel on a dangerous terror leader connects Colin and Bill to a family business engaged in terror operations. Now, they must find and turn a new asset to take down the entire operation. Meanwhile, Bill makes a shocking discovery.

episodes.name: Rare Earth
episodes.overview: When a foreign diplomat is killed after sneaking into the U.S. under unknown circumstances, Colin and Bill discover that a rare mineral with potential to disrupt international relations may be the reason he was targeted.

episodes.name: Forbidden Eye
episodes.overview: When Colin learns his CIA mentor has gone dark, he enlists Bill and the team to help track them down. But as they get closer, the operation reveals significant information about the identity of the mole.

episodes.name: Broken Glass
episodes.overview: Colin and Bill race to stop a company from covering up their intelligence theft while taking down a dangerous person from Colin's past.

episodes.name: The Deep
episodes.overview: A known cartel fixer arrives in New York City, and as the team gets busy tracking him down, they discover the body of a dead DEA agent. After it becomes clear the case is not what it seems, the team must work quickly to prevent additional murders. Meanwhile, Bill makes a shocking discovery when he returns to work after the death of his father, and the team enlists the help of FBI's Special Agent Stuart Scola.

reviews.author: MovieGuys
reviews.content:
"CIA" offers up decent actors in a bland action spy series.

The wholly forgettable, formlaic first episode, to me at least, made little coherent sense, accompanied by a predictable dash of "woke" codswallop. 

Acting is solid, but it's mired in a series that is, so far, pretty uninspiring.

In summary, a basic action spy drama, with the usual pro US rules the world narrative.

reviews.author: blodyholy
reviews.content: Fairly contrived procedural crime drama from CBS. Full of factual and clerical theatrical errors. Hard pass.
